purpose: Find the smallest smooth likelihood multiplier that retains the selected F_NP smoothness functional while keeping independent endpoints in the fixed cross-section fit region.
adaptive_rule: Run weights in ascending order and stop at the first weight for which all three endpoints satisfy the unweighted fit-quality ceiling.
primary_measure: cross-start F_NP distribution at x=0.1 and bT<=2 GeV^-1
interpretation: This is the Lagrangian form of minimizing the declared F_NP roughness subject to cross-section fit quality; unweighted chi2 remains the eligibility statistic.
